description_ru: Современные отложения. Аллювиально-морские (дельтовые) отложения. Пески или супеси
note: GGK-200 1st edition (Геологическая карта СССР, Карта четвертичных отложений, серия Тихвинско-Онежская) Q-37-XXXV,XXXVI (Arkhangelsk; 40-42E, 64-64d40mN), author V.G. Vartanov, editor E.A. Kalberg; approved by the NTS of the North-West TGU 10.06.1967 and the NRS of VSEGEI 18.06.1968; printed by the Leningrad cartographic factory of Aerogeologiya, signed to print 1.XII.1975 (thematic plan 1975); RASTER = geokniga FULL SCAN 8408x9851 px (~17 m/px), legend read on the sheet; the blue Holocene units differ by SCREEN not tint: WATER (horizontal lines), mIV (vertical lines), almIV (diagonal dot grid) detected by windowed FFT of the grey and B-R channels (work/r200e/prep_q3735.py; almIV only in the Dvina delta zone, mIV only in the northern coastal plain) and painted with synthetic colours onto the de-hatched scan (brighter half of a 9x9 window, work/r200e/prep_bright.py: lithology symbols, hatching and the red hummocky-moraine grid removed); natural tints calibrated on the de-hatched scan (preview_tint_calib.py); DROPPED after validation: lIV (0.4 % / 13.5 % agreement with Q-37_g3 / Q-35-37_g2; its tint caught river-bank and lake-shore edges) and PREQ (0 %; paint-edge and red bank-symbol mixtures) - their pixels go to the nearest other tint; units only on the sections (pIIIx vd, mIIIvd, glIIms) omitted; frame = 4 corners on the inner edge of the neatline + 60 minute-bar edge ties (5 min; ticks accepted against a local median: the scan is stitched and bent, the printed sides are straight and the right side bends 7 px), no interior graticule ; SCREEN-detected (diagonal dot grid), painted synthetic #00c000 by work/r200e/prep_q3735.py, only inside the Northern Dvina delta zone
